basic.name: Lightning Rush
basic.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Arlan's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Shackle Breaker
skill.description_template: Consumes Arlan's HP equal to 15% of his Max HP to deal Lightning DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Arlan's ATK to a single enemy. If Arlan does not have sufficient HP, his HP will be reduced to 1 after using his Skill.

ultimate.name: Frenzied Punishment
ultimate.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{main_damage}}% of Arlan's ATK to a single enemy and Lightning DMG equal to {{adjacent_damage}}% of Arlan's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

talent.name: Pain and Anger
talent.description_template: Based on Arlan's current missing HP percentage, gains DMG bonus, up to a maximum increase of {{dmg_boost}}% DMG dealt by Arlan.

technique.name: Swift Harvest
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Lightning DMG equal to 80% of Arlan's ATK to all enemies.

2.name: Revival
2.description: If the current HP percentage is 30% or lower when defeating an enemy, immediately restores HP equal to 20% of Max HP.

4.name: Endurance
4.description: The chance to resist DoT Debuffs increases by 50%.

6.name: Repel
6.description: Upon entering battle, if Arlan's HP percentage is less than or equal to 50%, he can nullify all DMG received except for DoTs until he is attacked.

eidolons.name: To the Bitter End
eidolons.description: When HP percentage is lower than or equal to 50% of Max HP, increases DMG dealt by Skill by 10%.

eidolons.name: Breaking Free
eidolons.description: Using Skill or Ultimate removes 1 debuff from this unit.

eidolons.name: Power Through
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Turn the Tables
eidolons.description: When struck by a killing blow after entering battle, instead of becoming knocked down, Arlan immediately restores his HP to 25% of his Max HP. This effect is automatically removed after it is triggered once or after 2 turn(s) have elapsed.

eidolons.name: Hammer and Tongs
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Self-Sacrifice
eidolons.description: When the current HP percentage drops to 50% or below, Ultimate deals 20% more DMG, and the DMG multiplier for adjacent targets is raised to the same level as that for the primary target.
